[![rgstr](https://rgstr.org/registry/computesdk/badge.svg?proof=rgstr_nm3kilaba5cfkkxo2lkh)](https://rgstr.org/registry/computesdk) [![rgstr](https://rgstr.org/registry/@computesdk/cli/badge.svg?proof=rgstr_un7pznm3kwv3xsaokzu4)](https://rgstr.org/registry/@computesdk/cli)
One router for sandboxes and Actions.
[![npm version](https://badge.fury.io/js/computesdk.svg)](https://badge.fury.io/js/computesdk) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-100%25-blue.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-computesdk.com-blue)](https://docs.computesdk.com)
--- ## ComputeSDK ComputeSDK is one router for sandboxes and Actions. Run agent code and GitHub workflows across compute providers through one integration. Let ComputeSDK route, choose a provider, or set a fallback order. Use the **CLI** from your terminal and the **TypeScript SDK** from your application or agent. - **Run commands and work with files** in cloud sandboxes from your terminal or TypeScript application. - **Sync local projects** to a sandbox for remote development and execution. - **Route compute centrally** using managed compute, your organization's provider keys, or both. - **Manage your organization** through one dashboard for credentials, credits and sandbox activity. [Open the dashboard](https://platform.computesdk.com) · [Read the docs](https://docs.computesdk.com) ## Start on a provider Create a sandbox on a specific provider through ComputeSDK: ```bash npm create modal # Or: npm create e2b ``` These starters install or upgrade the ComputeSDK CLI when needed, sign you in and create a sandbox pinned to that provider. They use your organization's managed-compute or BYOK routing. See [sandbox providers](docs/providers/README.md) for setup and cleanup. ## Start with the CLI ```bash npm install -g @computesdk/cli compute login compute sandboxes route compute new compute exec echo hello compute destroy ``` [Other installation options](docs/getting-started/installation.md) include macOS/Linux and Windows installers. Creation requires available credit or a configured BYOK route. Sandboxes keep running and billing until destroyed or their lifetime expires. ## Build with the TypeScript SDK ```typescript import { compute } from 'computesdk'; const sandbox = await compute.instances.create({ size: 'small' }); try { const result = await sandbox.runCommand('echo hello'); console.log(result.stdout); } finally { await sandbox.destroy(); } ``` ```bash npm install computesdk export COMPUTE_API_KEY="your_org_api_key" ``` Follow the [complete runnable SDK quickstart](docs/getting-started/sdk-quick-start.md) to create an API key and run this from Node.js. See [routing and BYOK](docs/guides/routing.md) to choose account modes and understand billing. ## Go further | Task | Guide | | --- | --- | | Send a local project to a sandbox | [Project sync](docs/cli/project-sync.md) | | Configure managed compute and BYOK | [Routing and billing](docs/guides/routing.md) | | Use the SDK in an application or agent | [TypeScript SDK](docs/sdk/README.md) | | Run workflows on sandbox providers | [Actions](docs/platform/actions.md) | | Connect an AI assistant | [MCP server](docs/platform/mcp.md) | ## Open-source SDK and contributing For direct vendor integrations, provider development and repository contribution instructions, see the [open-source SDK guide](OPEN_SOURCE.md). Individual adapters are documented in [their GitHub packages](https://github.com/computesdk/computesdk/tree/main/packages). ## Community and support [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/computesdk/computesdk/discussions) · [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/computesdk/computesdk/issues) ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
